parsedVerdict.reasoning: GateLog bypasses the module's persistence abstractions. In scanned() it ignores its injected PrismaService and creates a new PrismaClient from @prisma/client to write scan rows. In busiestGate() it queries the ORM directly with this.prisma.scan.findMany() and does the counting in business code. BoxOffice, in the same module, reaches persistence only through its injected EventStore and TicketStore ports, so the two files use persistence inconsistently. The candidate flags at GateLog.ts lines 8, 9 and 14 are confirmed by the source. Ticket sales and gate scans are related ticketing concerns, so the module does not split into unrelated concerns. The repeated Event construction in BoxOffice is data mapping, not a duplicated rule, and the source given shows no other duplicated rule.

violations.message: GateLog.scanned creates its own `new PrismaClient()` from @prisma/client and calls prisma.scan.create directly. This goes around the PrismaService injected into GateLog and around any store-style port.

GateLog.busiestGate runs ORM queries directly (this.prisma.scan.findMany()) in a business-layer class. BoxOffice in the same module uses store ports (EventStore/TicketStore), so the two files use persistence inconsistently.
